facts.title: Apple & Carrot "Superhero" Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups packed almond meal or almond flour (10 ounces)
1 ½ cups old-fashioned oats (certified gluten free if necessary)
Optional mix-ins: ½ cup chopped walnuts, or raisins or chocolate chips
½ cup honey or maple syrup
1 cup grated Granny Smith apple (about 1 ½ apples)
1 cup peeled and grated carrots (about 3 carrots)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
